verses.text: إِلَى غَيْرِنَا قَدْ وَجَّهَ الْكَيْدَ وَالسَّعْيَا
verses.transcription: ilaa ghayrinaa qad wajjahal kayda was sah-yaa

verses.text: ظَلُومٌ وَشَيْطَانٌ بِمَنْ قَادَ لِى الرَّعْيَا
verses.transcription: zaluumun wa shaytaanun biman qaada lir rah-yaa

verses.text: عَنِ اللَّهِ وَالْمُخْتَارِ قَدْ صِرْتُ رَاضِيَا
verses.transcription: hanil laahi wal mukhtaari qad sirtu raadiyaa

verses.text: وَقَدْ كَبْكَبَ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ بَآءَ مَخْفِيَّا
verses.transcription: wa qad kabkabash shaytaana qad baa-a mukhfiyyaa

verses.text: وُجُوهُ صِحَابِ الْمُنْتَقَى وَاجَهُواْ الْعِدَى
verses.transcription: wujuuhu sihaabil muntaqaa waajahul hidaa

verses.text: بِطَرْدٍ وَإِرْدَآءٍ كَمَآ أَدْمَنُواْ النَّفْيَا
verses.transcription: bitardin wa irdaa-in kamaa admanun naf-yaa

verses.text: ذَبَبْتُ الْعِدَى بِاللَّهِ وَالْمُنْتَقَى النَّبِى
verses.transcription: zababtul hidaa bil laahi wal muntaqan nabii

verses.text: فُرَادِى وَمُثْنِى أَدْبَرُواْ لَا زَمُواْ الْحَرْبَا
verses.transcription: furaadii wa musnii adbaruu laa zamul harbaa

verses.text: بِرِأْتُ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ مِنْ كُلِّ مُشْرِكٍ
verses.transcription: bari-tu liwajhil laahi min kulli mushrikin

verses.text: خَلِيلًا حَبِيبًا لِلَّذِى طَيَّبَ الْمَحْيَا
verses.transcription: khaliilan habiiban lil lazii tayyabal mah-yaa

verses.text: أَجَابَنِىَ الْبَاقِى الَّذِى لَا يَرُدُّ لِى
verses.transcription: ajaabaniyal baaqil lazii laa yuruddu lii

verses.text: كَحِ الْمُشْتَرَاةَ الدَّهْرَ مُذْ قَادَ لِى طَيَّا
verses.transcription: kahil mushtaraatad dahra muz qaada lii tayyaa

verses.text: لِمَنْ زَحْزَحَ الْأَعْدَآءِ بِالْخِزْىِ سَرْمَدَا
verses.transcription: liman zahzahal ahdaa-i bil khiz-yi sarmadaa

verses.text: إِلَى غَيْرِىَ الْحَمْدُ الَّذِى قَادَ لِى الْبُغْيَى
verses.transcription: ilaa ghayriyal hamdul lazii qaada lil bugh-yaa

verses.text: لِرَبِّى الَّذِى لَا يُصِلُ الدَّهْرَ لِى أَذًى
verses.transcription: lirabbil lazii laa yusilud dahra lii azan

verses.text: شُكُورِى وَحَمْدِى تَارِكًا مَّاحَوَى نَهْيَا
verses.transcription: shukuurii wa hamdii taarikan maahawaa nah-yaa

verses.text: هُوَ اللَّهُ وَالرَّحْمَانُ وَهْوَ الرَّحِيمُ مَنْ
verses.transcription: huwal laahu war rahmaanu wahwar rahiimu man

verses.text: إِلَيْهِ انْتَحَى بِالْمُنْتَقَى دَامَ مَرْضِيَّا
verses.transcription: ilayhin tahaa bil muntaqaa daama mardiyyaa

verses.text: مُحَمَّدٌ الْمُخْتَارُ قَدْ بَانَ كَوْنُهُ
verses.transcription: muhammadunal mukhtaaru qad baana kawnuhu

verses.text: رَئِيسَ الْوَرَى مَنْ رَّدَّهُ لَازَمَ الْغَيَّا
verses.transcription: ra-iisal waraa man raddahu laazamal ghayyaa

verses.text: نَبِىٌّ رَّسُولٌ وَالْمَزَايَا جَلِيَّةٌ
verses.transcription: nabiyyun rasuulun wal mazaayaa jaliyyatun

verses.text: وَوَجَّهَهُ لِلْخَلْقِ مَنْ لَّمْ يَزَلْ حَيَّا
verses.transcription: wa wajjahahu lil khalqi man lam yazal hayyaa

verses.text: أَزَالَ بِهِ الرَّحْمَانُ مَا قَدْ نَحَا الْعِدَى
verses.transcription: azaala bihir rahmaanu maa qad nahal hidaa

verses.text: عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةُ اللَّهِ مَا جَادَ وَاسْتَحْيَى
verses.transcription: halayhi salaatul laahi maa jaada wastah-yaa

verses.text: لَهُ مَا نَفَى الشَّيْطَانَ وَالضُّرَّ وَالْبَلَآ
verses.transcription: lahu maa nafash shaytaana wad durra wal balaa

verses.text: إِلَى غَيْرِنَا وَانْقَادَ لِى الصَّفْوُ وَالْبُغْيَى
verses.transcription: ilaa ghayrinaa wan qaada lis safwu wal bugh-yaa

verses.text: شَكَرْتُ الَّذِى أَرْدَى عَدُوِّ مُوَجِّهًا
verses.transcription: shakartul lazii ardaa haduwwi muwajjihan

verses.text: إِلَى غَيْرِىَ الشَّيْطَانَ بِالْيَأْسِ مَنْفِيَّا
verses.transcription: ilaa ghayriyash shaytaana bil ya-si manfiyyaa

verses.text: يَسُوقُ لِغَيْرِى مَنْ هَدَانِى بِذِكْرِهِ
verses.transcription: yasuuqu lighayrii man hadaanii bizikrihi

verses.text: لَعِينًا وَمَنْ لَّا يَطْلُبُ الْفَهْمَ وَالدِّرْيَا
verses.transcription: lahiinan wa man laa yatlubul fahma wad dir-yaa

verses.text: طَوَافُ الْعِدَى طُرًّ لِغَيْرِى فَمَنْ أَبَى
verses.transcription: tawaaful hidaa turran lighayrii faman abaa

verses.text: مَسَالَمَتِى بِالتَّوْبِ لَا يَحْتَوِى هَدْيَا
verses.transcription: masaalamatii bit tawbi laa yahtawii had-yaa

verses.text: أَجَابَنِىَ الْبَاقِى الَّذِى قَادَ كَحْ مَعَا
verses.transcription: ajaabaniyal baaqil lazii qaada kah mahaa

verses.text: لِغَيْرِى وَلِى قَادَ الْمُنَى لَآ أُرَى بَغْيَا
verses.transcription: lighayrii wa lii qaadal munaa laa uraa bagh-yaa

verses.text: نَفَى كَحْ لِغَيْرِى سَرْمَدًا خَيْرُ شَافِعٍ
verses.transcription: nafaa kah lighayrii sarmadan khayru shaafihin

verses.text: يُوَجِّهُ لِى الْبَاقِى بِهِ الشِّبْعَِ وَالرِّيَّا
verses.transcription: yuwajjihu lil baaqii bihish shibha war riyyaa

verses.text: إِلَى غَيْرِ حِبِّ اللَّهِ حِبِّ رَسُولِهِ
verses.transcription: ilaa ghayri hibbil laahi hibbi rasuulihi

verses.text: يَمِيلُ الَّذِى لَمْ يَقْبَلِ الْبِرَّ وَالْوَحْيَا
verses.transcription: yamiilul lazii lam yaqbalil birra wal wah-yaa

verses.text: لَقَدْ بَانَ لِى أَنَّ الْمُقَفَّى رَسُولُ مَنْ
verses.transcription: laqad baana lii annal muqaffaa rasuulu man

verses.text: يُّخَلِّدُ لِى سِرًّا يُوَلِى الْعِدَى خِزْيَا
verses.transcription: yukhallidu lii sirran yuwalil hidaa khiz-yaa

verses.text: رَفَعْتُ ثَنَآءِ لِلْمُقَفَّى وَحِزْبِهِ
verses.transcription: rafahtu sanaa-i lil muqaffaa wa hizbihi

verses.text: كَمَا قَصْدَ كَحْ نَحْوِى مَحَا رَبُّهُ مَحْيَا
verses.transcription: kamaa qasda kah nahwii mahaa rabbuhu mah-yaa

verses.text: جَزَآءُ الَّذِى لِى فِيدَ فِى عَامِ دَكْسَشٍ
verses.transcription: jazaa-ul lazii lii qiida fii haami daksashin

verses.text: جَزَاءُ مِّنَ الْمَاحِى الْعَنَآ مُذْ مَحَا الْخَشْيَا
verses.transcription: jazaa-u minal maahil hanaa muz mahal khash-yaa

verses.text: يَسُوقُ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهُ كُلَّ مُفَنِّدٍ
verses.transcription: yasuuqu lighayril laahu kulla mufannidin

verses.text: طَرِيدًا إِلَى غَيْرِى دَوَامًا بِلَا لُقْيَى
verses.transcription: tariidan ilaa ghayrii dawaaman bilaa luq-yaa

verses.text: مَحَا قَصْدَ كَحْ لِى مَنْ هَدَانِى بِرَبِّهِ
verses.transcription: mahaa qasda kah lii man hadaanii birabbihi

verses.text: عَلَيْهِ سَلَامَا مَنْ بِهِ قَادَ لِى الرَّعْيَا
verses.transcription: halayhi salaamaa man bihi qaada lir rah-yaa

bayts.text: إِلَى غَيْرِنَا قَدْ وَجَّهَ الْكَيْدَ وَالسَّعْيَا ۞ ظَلُومٌ وَشَيْطَانٌ بِمَنْ قَادَ لِى الرَّعْيَا

translations.it.karamati: Verso altri che noi hanno rivolto l'insidia e lo sforzo un iniquo e un Satana, per (la grazia di) Colui che ha condotto a me la tutela.
translations.en.karamati: Toward others than us an oppressor and a Satan have turned their plot and striving, by (the grace of) Him Who led protection to me.
translations.fr.karamati: C'est vers d'autres que nous qu'un injuste et un Satan ont tourné la ruse et l'effort, par (la grâce de) Celui qui m'a amené la protection.

bayts.text: عَنِ اللَّهِ وَالْمُخْتَارِ قَدْ صِرْتُ رَاضِيَا ۞ وَقَدْ كَبْكَبَ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ بَآءَ مَخْفِيَّا

translations.it.karamati: Di Allah e dell'Eletto sono divenuto compiaciuto, e (Allah) ha precipitato Satana, che se n'è tornato nascosto (nella vergogna).
translations.en.karamati: With Allah and the Chosen One I have become well pleased, and (Allah) has hurled Satan down, who has gone back hidden (in shame).
translations.fr.karamati: D'Allah et de l'Élu je suis devenu satisfait, et (Allah) a précipité Satan, qui s'en est retourné caché (dans la honte).

bayts.text: وُجُوهُ صِحَابِ الْمُنْتَقَى وَاجَهُواْ الْعِدَى ۞ بِطَرْدٍ وَإِرْدَآءٍ كَمَآ أَدْمَنُواْ النَّفْيَا

translations.it.karamati: I volti dei Compagni del Prescelto hanno fronteggiato i nemici con la cacciata e l'abbattimento, così come hanno perseverato nel respingerli.
translations.en.karamati: The faces of the Companions of the Select One confronted the enemies with expulsion and overthrow, as they persisted in repelling them.
translations.fr.karamati: Les visages des Compagnons du Préféré ont affronté les ennemis par l'expulsion et l'abattement, de même qu'ils ont persévéré à les repousser.

bayts.text: ذَبَبْتُ الْعِدَى بِاللَّهِ وَالْمُنْتَقَى النَّبِى ۞ فُرَادِى وَمُثْنِى أَدْبَرُواْ لَا زَمُواْ الْحَرْبَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho respinto i nemici per mezzo di Allah e del Prescelto, il Profeta: a uno a uno e a due a due voltarono le spalle, attenendosi alla fuga.
translations.en.karamati: I repelled the enemies through Allah and the Select One, the Prophet: one by one and two by two they turned their backs, keeping to flight.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai repoussé les ennemis par Allah et par le Préféré, le Prophète : un à un et deux à deux ils tournèrent le dos, s'en tenant à la fuite.

bayts.text: بِرِأْتُ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ مِنْ كُلِّ مُشْرِكٍ ۞ خَلِيلًا حَبِيبًا لِلَّذِى طَيَّبَ الْمَحْيَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi sono dissociato, per il Volto di Allah, da ogni associatore, (divenendo) amico intimo e diletto di colui che ha reso buona la vita.
translations.en.karamati: I have dissociated myself, for the Face of Allah, from every idolater, (becoming) intimate friend and beloved of him who made life good.
translations.fr.karamati: Je me suis désolidarisé, pour la Face d'Allah, de tout associateur, (devenant) ami intime et bien-aimé de celui qui a rendu la vie bonne.

bayts.text: أَجَابَنِىَ الْبَاقِى الَّذِى لَا يَرُدُّ لِى ۞ كَحِ الْمُشْتَرَاةَ الدَّهْرَ مُذْ قَادَ لِى طَيَّا

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha esaudito il Permanente (Al-Bāqī), che mai rivolge contro di me ogni avversario invidioso prezzolato, da quando ha condotto a me il ripiegamento (delle distanze).
translations.en.karamati: The Everlasting (Al-Bāqī) has answered me, Who never turns any hired envious adversary against me, since He led to me the folding (of distances).
translations.fr.karamati: M'a exaucé le Permanent (Al-Bāqī), qui ne retourne jamais contre moi tout adversaire envieux soudoyé, depuis qu'Il m'a amené le repliement (des distances).

bayts.text: لِمَنْ زَحْزَحَ الْأَعْدَآءِ بِالْخِزْىِ سَرْمَدَا ۞ إِلَى غَيْرِىَ الْحَمْدُ الَّذِى قَادَ لِى الْبُغْيَى

translations.it.karamati: A Colui che ha allontanato per sempre i nemici, con l'ignominia, verso altri che me, la lode: (Colui) che ha condotto a me l'oggetto del mio desiderio.
translations.en.karamati: To Him Who has driven the enemies for ever, in disgrace, toward others than me, be praise: (He) Who led to me the object of my desire.
translations.fr.karamati: À Celui qui a écarté pour toujours les ennemis, par l'ignominie, vers d'autres que moi, la louange : (Celui) qui m'a amené l'objet de mon désir.

bayts.text: لِرَبِّى الَّذِى لَا يُصِلُ الدَّهْرَ لِى أَذًى ۞ شُكُورِى وَحَمْدِى تَارِكًا مَّاحَوَى نَهْيَا

translations.it.karamati: Al mio Signore, che mai fa giungere a me alcun danno, la mia gratitudine e la mia lode, abbandonando ciò che racchiude un divieto.
translations.en.karamati: To my Lord, Who never lets any harm reach me, my gratitude and my praise, forsaking whatever holds a prohibition.
translations.fr.karamati: À mon Seigneur, qui jamais ne fait parvenir jusqu'à moi aucun mal, ma gratitude et ma louange, en délaissant ce qui renferme un interdit.

bayts.text: هُوَ اللَّهُ وَالرَّحْمَانُ وَهْوَ الرَّحِيمُ مَنْ ۞ إِلَيْهِ انْتَحَى بِالْمُنْتَقَى دَامَ مَرْضِيَّا

translations.it.karamati: Egli è Allah, il Compassionevole (Ar-Raḥmān), ed Egli è il Misericordioso (Ar-Raḥīm): chi si dirige a Lui per mezzo del Prescelto resta per sempre gradito.
translations.en.karamati: He is Allah, the All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), and He is the Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm): whoever turns to Him through the Select One remains for ever well-pleasing.
translations.fr.karamati: Il est Allah, le Tout-Miséricordieux (Ar-Raḥmān), et Il est le Très-Miséricordieux (Ar-Raḥīm) : qui se dirige vers Lui par le Préféré demeure pour toujours agréé.

bayts.text: مُحَمَّدٌ الْمُخْتَارُ قَدْ بَانَ كَوْنُهُ ۞ رَئِيسَ الْوَرَى مَنْ رَّدَّهُ لَازَمَ الْغَيَّا

translations.it.karamati: Muḥammad, l'Eletto: è divenuto chiaro che egli è il capo delle creature; chi lo respinge si attiene al traviamento.
translations.en.karamati: Muḥammad, the Chosen One: it has become clear that he is the chief of creation; whoever rejects him clings to error.
translations.fr.karamati: Muḥammad, l'Élu : il est devenu clair qu'il est le chef des créatures ; qui le rejette s'attache à l'égarement.

bayts.text: نَبِىٌّ رَّسُولٌ وَالْمَزَايَا جَلِيَّةٌ ۞ وَوَجَّهَهُ لِلْخَلْقِ مَنْ لَّمْ يَزَلْ حَيَّا

translations.it.karamati: Profeta, Inviato – e i suoi privilegi sono evidenti –: lo ha inviato alle creature Colui che non cessa di essere Vivente (Al-Ḥayy).
translations.en.karamati: Prophet, Messenger – and his distinctions are manifest –: He Who never ceases to be Living (Al-Ḥayy) sent him to creation.
translations.fr.karamati: Prophète, Envoyé – et ses privilèges sont évidents – : l'a envoyé aux créatures Celui qui ne cesse d'être Vivant (Al-Ḥayy).

bayts.text: أَزَالَ بِهِ الرَّحْمَانُ مَا قَدْ نَحَا الْعِدَى ۞ عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةُ اللَّهِ مَا جَادَ وَاسْتَحْيَى

translations.it.karamati: Per mezzo di lui il Compassionevole (Ar-Raḥmān) ha rimosso ciò a cui miravano i nemici: su di lui la benedizione di Allah, per quanto egli fu generoso e pudico.
translations.en.karamati: Through him the All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān) removed what the enemies aimed at: upon him the blessing of Allah, as much as he was generous and modest.
translations.fr.karamati: Par lui le Tout-Miséricordieux (Ar-Raḥmān) a ôté ce que visaient les ennemis : sur lui la bénédiction d'Allah, autant qu'il fut généreux et pudique.

bayts.text: لَهُ مَا نَفَى الشَّيْطَانَ وَالضُّرَّ وَالْبَلَآ ۞ إِلَى غَيْرِنَا وَانْقَادَ لِى الصَّفْوُ وَالْبُغْيَى

translations.it.karamati: A Lui (la lode) per aver respinto Satana, il danno e la prova verso altri che noi, e perché si sono sottomessi a me la serenità e l'oggetto del desiderio.
translations.en.karamati: To Him (be praise) for repelling Satan, harm and trial toward others than us, and because serenity and the object of desire have yielded to me.
translations.fr.karamati: À Lui (la louange) pour avoir repoussé Satan, le mal et l'épreuve vers d'autres que nous, et parce que se sont soumis à moi la sérénité et l'objet du désir.

bayts.text: شَكَرْتُ الَّذِى أَرْدَى عَدُوِّ مُوَجِّهًا ۞ إِلَى غَيْرِىَ الشَّيْطَانَ بِالْيَأْسِ مَنْفِيَّا

translations.it.karamati: Ho ringraziato Colui che ha abbattuto il mio nemico, rivolgendo verso altri che me Satana, respinto nella disperazione.
translations.en.karamati: I have thanked Him Who struck down my enemy, turning Satan toward others than me, repelled in despair.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai remercié Celui qui a abattu mon ennemi, tournant vers d'autres que moi Satan, repoussé dans le désespoir.

bayts.text: يَسُوقُ لِغَيْرِى مَنْ هَدَانِى بِذِكْرِهِ ۞ لَعِينًا وَمَنْ لَّا يَطْلُبُ الْفَهْمَ وَالدِّرْيَا

translations.it.karamati: Colui che mi ha guidato con il Suo ricordo spinge verso altri che me il Maledetto (Satana) e chi non cerca la comprensione e il sapere.
translations.en.karamati: He Who guided me with His remembrance drives toward others than me the Accursed (Satan) and whoever seeks not understanding and knowledge.
translations.fr.karamati: Celui qui m'a guidé par Son rappel pousse vers d'autres que moi le Maudit (Satan) et quiconque ne recherche ni la compréhension ni le savoir.

bayts.text: طَوَافُ الْعِدَى طُرًّ لِغَيْرِى فَمَنْ أَبَى ۞ مَسَالَمَتِى بِالتَّوْبِ لَا يَحْتَوِى هَدْيَا

translations.it.karamati: L'aggirarsi di tutti i nemici è verso altri che me: chi rifiuta la pace con me, mediante il pentimento, non otterrà la retta guida.
translations.en.karamati: The prowling of all the enemies is toward others than me: whoever refuses peace with me, through repentance, shall not attain right guidance.
translations.fr.karamati: Le rôdement de tous les ennemis va vers d'autres que moi : qui refuse la paix avec moi, par le repentir, n'obtiendra pas la droite guidance.

bayts.text: أَجَابَنِىَ الْبَاقِى الَّذِى قَادَ كَحْ مَعَا ۞ لِغَيْرِى وَلِى قَادَ الْمُنَى لَآ أُرَى بَغْيَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha esaudito il Permanente (Al-Bāqī), che ha condotto ogni avversario invidioso, tutti insieme, verso altri che me, e a me ha condotto i desideri: non mi si vede (commettere) prevaricazione.
translations.en.karamati: The Everlasting (Al-Bāqī) has answered me, Who led every envious adversary, all together, toward others than me, and led my wishes to me: I am not seen (committing) transgression.
translations.fr.karamati: M'a exaucé le Permanent (Al-Bāqī), qui a mené tout adversaire envieux, tous ensemble, vers d'autres que moi, et vers moi a mené les souhaits : on ne me voit (commettre) nulle transgression.

bayts.text: نَفَى كَحْ لِغَيْرِى سَرْمَدًا خَيْرُ شَافِعٍ ۞ يُوَجِّهُ لِى الْبَاقِى بِهِ الشِّبْعَِ وَالرِّيَّا

translations.it.karamati: Il migliore degli intercessori ha respinto per sempre ogni avversario invidioso verso altri che me; per mezzo di lui il Permanente rivolge a me la sazietà e l'abbeveramento.
translations.en.karamati: The best of intercessors has repelled every envious adversary for ever toward others than me; through him the Everlasting turns satiety and quenching toward me.
translations.fr.karamati: Le meilleur des intercesseurs a repoussé pour toujours tout adversaire envieux vers d'autres que moi ; par lui le Permanent tourne vers moi la satiété et l'abreuvement.

bayts.text: إِلَى غَيْرِ حِبِّ اللَّهِ حِبِّ رَسُولِهِ ۞ يَمِيلُ الَّذِى لَمْ يَقْبَلِ الْبِرَّ وَالْوَحْيَا

translations.it.karamati: Verso altri che l'amato di Allah, l'amato del Suo Inviato, piega colui che non ha accolto la pietà e la Rivelazione.
translations.en.karamati: Toward others than the beloved of Allah, the beloved of His Messenger, inclines whoever has not accepted piety and Revelation.
translations.fr.karamati: Vers d'autres que le bien-aimé d'Allah, le bien-aimé de Son Envoyé, penche celui qui n'a pas accueilli la piété et la Révélation.

bayts.text: لَقَدْ بَانَ لِى أَنَّ الْمُقَفَّى رَسُولُ مَنْ ۞ يُّخَلِّدُ لِى سِرًّا يُوَلِى الْعِدَى خِزْيَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi è divenuto chiaro che l'Ultimo venuto (Muḥammad) è l'Inviato di Colui che rende eterno per me un segreto e infligge ai nemici l'ignominia.
translations.en.karamati: It has become clear to me that the Last to Come (Muḥammad) is the Messenger of Him Who makes a secret everlasting for me and visits disgrace upon the enemies.
translations.fr.karamati: Il m'est devenu clair que le Dernier venu (Muḥammad) est l'Envoyé de Celui qui rend éternel pour moi un secret et inflige aux ennemis l'ignominie.

bayts.text: رَفَعْتُ ثَنَآءِ لِلْمُقَفَّى وَحِزْبِهِ ۞ كَمَا قَصْدَ كَحْ نَحْوِى مَحَا رَبُّهُ مَحْيَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho innalzato la mia lode all'Ultimo venuto (Muḥammad) e al suo partito, così come il suo Signore ha cancellato del tutto l'intento di ogni avversario invidioso contro di me.
translations.en.karamati: I have raised my praise to the Last to Come (Muḥammad) and his party, just as his Lord wholly erased the design of every envious adversary against me.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai élevé ma louange au Dernier venu (Muḥammad) et à son parti, de même que son Seigneur a entièrement effacé le dessein de tout adversaire envieux contre moi.

bayts.text: جَزَآءُ الَّذِى لِى فِيدَ فِى عَامِ دَكْسَشٍ ۞ جَزَاءُ مِّنَ الْمَاحِى الْعَنَآ مُذْ مَحَا الْخَشْيَا

translations.it.karamati: La ricompensa di ciò che mi è stato concesso nell'anno Daksash (1324 H / 1906-07) è una ricompensa da parte di colui che cancella la pena (Al-Māḥī, Muḥammad), da quando ha cancellato il timore.
translations.en.karamati: The reward for what was granted me in the year Daksash (1324 AH / 1906-07) is a reward from the Effacer of hardship (Al-Māḥī, Muḥammad), since he erased fear.
translations.fr.karamati: La récompense de ce qui m'a été accordé en l'année Daksash (1324 H / 1906-07) est une récompense de la part de celui qui efface la peine (Al-Māḥī, Muḥammad), depuis qu'il a effacé la crainte.

bayts.text: يَسُوقُ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهُ كُلَّ مُفَنِّدٍ ۞ طَرِيدًا إِلَى غَيْرِى دَوَامًا بِلَا لُقْيَى

translations.it.karamati: Allah spinge verso altri ogni calunniatore, scacciato verso altri che me, per sempre, senza incontro.
translations.en.karamati: Allah drives every slanderer toward others, banished toward others than me, for ever, with no meeting.
translations.fr.karamati: Allah pousse vers d'autres tout calomniateur, chassé vers d'autres que moi, pour toujours, sans rencontre.

bayts.text: مَحَا قَصْدَ كَحْ لِى مَنْ هَدَانِى بِرَبِّهِ ۞ عَلَيْهِ سَلَامَا مَنْ بِهِ قَادَ لِى الرَّعْيَا

translations.it.karamati: Ha cancellato l'intento di ogni avversario invidioso contro di me colui che mi ha guidato al suo Signore (Muḥammad): su di lui il saluto di Colui che, per mezzo di lui, ha condotto a me la tutela.
translations.en.karamati: He who guided me to his Lord (Muḥammad) has erased the design of every envious adversary against me: upon him the peace of Him Who, through him, led protection to me.
translations.fr.karamati: A effacé le dessein de tout adversaire envieux contre moi celui qui m'a guidé vers son Seigneur (Muḥammad) : sur lui le salut de Celui qui, par lui, m'a amené la protection.
